一、三条定点修改逐条核（都自己读盘，不采信派活里的转述）：
- 000004（方位词 below 指反）：**fixed**。main.tex 第 153 行现逐字「For it, and only for it among the five results above, no verified full-text source is at hand …」；五个定理环境（thm:sylow1/2/3/index/unique）全在该段之上，「the argument following」保留且指紧随其后的 proof（155 行起）——方向对了。
- 000005（第 3 节 in this project / we therefore record it）：**fixed**。原两句已不在盘上；fs.search(pattern="in this project|this project|we therefore record|ledger|internal record|sha256|本轮|验收表|five results below", out/package/main.tex) → total=0。新句只作事实陈述（无经核验全文来源 / 论证未经独立核验 / 仅求完整，不主张为独立验证过的证明），没有抬高强度。
- 000006（附录 A 的 ledger / recorded / provenance label）：**fixed**。第 197 行现逐字「…where the corresponding source material may be consulted and under which label the statement and its argument are filed. Those labels are provenance marks, not mathematical content.」；第 209 行现逐字「…for the statements stmt:000060 through stmt:000063 the source material includes a line-by-line review of the proof; for stmt:000064 that review reported an error (the statement and the proof were found not to match)…」——「ledger」零命中，事实（000060–000063 有逐行审阅、000064 被判有毛病）原样保留，无抬高。
